_meta.task: Mobile UI Polish Pass — VELLUM design system, spatial design, color theory, 2026 best practices

references.ios26_liquid_glass: iOS 26 Liquid Glass: frosted specular glass on warm paper backgrounds; BlurView intensity 80-100, hairline specular border at top, warm tint overlay; degrades to solid on Android
references.editorial_typography: Measure 50-65 chars/line; body 16px/24px lineHeight; heading 22-26px/1.2-1.25; caption 12px/18px; eyebrow 11px uppercase 0.08em tracking; Fraunces for editorial titles
references.micro_interactions: Spring tension:200 friction:20 for appear (slight overshoot); 160ms ease-in for dismiss; tap: opacity 0.65-0.75 in 80ms; state change 150ms ease-in-out
references.empty_skeleton_states: Skeleton shimmer 900ms opacity 0.35→0.65 loop; EmptyState: 56px icon circle + 18px headline + 14px body + 44px CTA button; all centered
references.touch_targets: minHeight 44pt on all interactive rows; hitSlop {top:10, bottom:10, left:10, right:10} for icon-only buttons; disabled opacity: 0.38
references.safe_area_spacing: useSafeAreaInsets() on every screen; header = insets.top + 56; bottom content = insets.bottom + 24; screen gutter 16px horizontal
